cell_type_model: human osteoblastic cells

pathway_branch: WNT3 -> ROR2-associated canonical Wnt modulation -> cytosolic beta-catenin/reporter output in osteoblastic cells

cell_type_model: mouse cortical neural progenitors; in vivo developing cortex

relation_type: WNT3 associates with and activates a cleavage-dependent RYK relay

cell_type_model: mouse embryonic fibroblasts; HEK293T; Xenopus embryos
assay_or_perturbation: WNT5A/PTK7 co-IP and domain deletion; PTK7 knockout/rescue; JNK phosphorylation; AP-1 reporter; wound healing/migration
relation_type: WNT5A binds PTK7 in a context-dependent receptor/co-receptor branch and PTK7 is required for WNT5A-induced JNK/motility outputs

limitations: One primary Xenopus study (PMID:21772251) detected PTK7 with WNT3A/WNT8 but not WNT5A in its co-IP assay; later mammalian/Xenopus work (PMID:26499793) directly reported WNT5A-PTK7 association and PTK7-dependent JNK/motility. Do not generalize across ligand or receptor context.
